about: Generated sound effects under Content/Audio/Gen (docs/unreal/AUDIO.md section 6): one text-to-audio generation per file (model mirelo_text_to_audio, 0.25 credits per second). 'cut' is how tools/audio/sfx_process.py makes the game file: oneshot = the loudest event from its onset, 'len' seconds, faded; loop = the middle 'len' seconds with a crossfaded seam; peak = the normalisation target (the web sound's peak, so the mix of spec 07 holds). All placeholders until recorded or licensed material replaces them file for file.

chopper_close.prompt: Close-up single gunshot of a 5.56 millimetre carbine rifle fired outdoors, sharp supersonic crack and punchy chest-thump body, very short and dry, no echo, no reverb

chopper_mech.prompt: Close metallic clack of a rifle bolt carrier cycling, steel parts slamming, mechanical action only, no gunshot, dry studio

chopper_tail.prompt: Echo tail of a rifle shot rolling off city buildings and concrete, distant slapback reflections fading out, the initial gunshot removed, outdoor urban street

chopper_sup.prompt: Close-up suppressed rifle gunshot, muffled heavy thump with a sharp metallic action clack, no supersonic crack, dry

nine_close.prompt: Close-up single 9 millimetre pistol gunshot fired outdoors, snappy sharp crack with a short punch, dry, no echo

nine_mech.prompt: Close metallic clack of a pistol slide cycling back and forward, mechanical only, no gunshot, dry

nine_tail.prompt: Echo tail of a pistol shot bouncing between city buildings, short urban slapback fading out, the initial gunshot removed

nine_sup.prompt: Close-up suppressed pistol shot, soft muffled pop with a crisp slide clack, no crack, dry
